verdict.rationale: Milvus documents an official MCP server (zilliztech/mcp-server-milvus) that lets AI applications run vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data using natural-language commands instead of hand-written queries. That natural-language operation is real but indirect: it depends on an external AI/MCP client to interpret the commands, and the evidence is a single tutorial page. Missing for 10: native natural-language interface within Milvus itself, documentation of which operations are covered (e.g., admin, RBAC, schema changes), independent or hands-on corroboration of how well it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This tutorial walks you through setting up an MCP server for Milvus, allowing AI applications to perform vector searches, manage collections, and retrieve data using natural language commands—without writing custom database queries.
